headline: Mexican economy could grow up to 2% in 2026 due to export strength: Monex
summary: Monex's chief economic analyst Janneth Quiroz expects Mexican growth of 1.9% to 2% this year, after the economy's best third-quarter performance. Export strength is cited as a driver.
why: Mexico is Latin America's second-largest economy and a major manufacturing exporter, so its growth outlook shapes regional and emerging-market investment decisions.
original_headline: Economía mexicana crecería hasta 2% en 2026 por la fortaleza exportadora: Monex
